CustomField.description: This field determines the Mosaic Quality Risk Score (MQRS)
CustomField.formula: CASE(PMC_SS_IncidentFrequency__c, "1st Occurrence", 1, "2nd Occurrence", 2, "More than 2 Occurrences", 3, 0) + CASE(PMC_SS_IncidentProbability__c, "Not Likely", 0, "Likely", 1, "Very Likely", 2, 0) + CASE(PMC_SS_IncidentSeverity__c, "$0 - $1,000", 0, "$1,001 - $5,000", 1, "$5,001 - $15,000", 2, "$15,001 - $25,000", 3, "$25,001 - $50,000", 4, "More than $50,000", 5, 0) + CASE(PMC_SS_CustomerImpact__c, "No Impact to Customer’s Supply / Operations / Safety / Health", 0, "Minor Impact to Customer’s Supply / Operations / Safety / Health", 1, "Significant Impact to Customer’s Supply / Operations / Safety / Health", 3, "Rejection / Loss of Cargo and/or Risk of Losing a Customer", 5, 0) + CASE(PMC_SS_IncidentQuantity__c, "0 – 100 tons", 0, "101 – 1,000 tons", 1, "1,001 – 3,000 tons", 3, "Greater than 3,000 tons", 5, 0)
CustomField.label: Total Score
